[**Work in progress**]{.status-tag} · 2026

> *Subnational disability prevalence using harmonized data from 26 countries (DHS and MICS surveys 2016–2022). The highest-burden areas cluster along the Ghana–Togo and Central African Republic–DRC borders, in southern DRC, and in parts of Madagascar.*
